/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 2. stepper */
var SC=STEP.cats, kr=STEP.fork_tokens[0], prim=STEP.fork_tokens[1];
function phat(tok,cls){return tok.phat[SC.indexOf(cls)];}
var EX=STEP.exchange.B3;
var specStart=STEP.prompt.indexOf('Task:');
function promptHTML(){var p=STEP.prompt, i=p.indexOf('Task:'), j=p.indexOf('Use only the Python');
  return esc(p.slice(0,i))+'<mark class="spec">'+esc(p.slice(i,j))+'</mark>'+esc(p.slice(j));}
var STAGES=[
 {key:'prompt',name:'Prompt',
  inn:'<pre>'+promptHTML()+'</pre>',
  done:'<p>The model reads the prompt. The highlighted span is where the task is stated. The opening sentence is a <button type="button" class="term" data-term="exchange">neutral twin</button> of a ban: the same prohibition frame with an irrelevant noun ("'+esc(STEP.prompt_segment.split(' for ')[0].replace('Do not use ',''))+'").</p>',
  out:'<p>Residual-stream activations at every prompt token.</p>',
  why:'<p>The algorithm is never named. Whatever the model writes is its own default for this task.</p>'},
 {key:'spec',name:'Task states',
  inn:'<p>The <button type="button" class="term" data-term="spec">task specification states</button> at blocks 12 to 23: the activations over the highlighted span.</p>',
  done:'<p>Test of what they carry: a <button type="button" class="term" data-term="exchange">task-state exchange</button> writes the states of a prompt that asks for Prim into a padding twin, on '+EX.n+' shared streams.</p>',
  out:'<p>Prim in <b>'+fmt(EX.exch*EX.n,0)+' of '+EX.n+'</b> streams after the exchange, against '+fmt(EX.twin*EX.n,0)+' of '+EX.n+' for the twin alone and '+fmt(EX.mr*EX.n,0)+' of '+EX.n+' for a random exchange of matched norm (discordant pairs '+EX.b+':'+EX.c+', <i>p</i> = '+fmtSci(EX.p,1)+'). The fork margin moved '+fmt(EX.dm_exch,2)+' nats toward Prim, against '+fmt(EX.dm_mr,2)+' for the random exchange.</p>',
  why:'<p>The choice is carried by these states into the fork. A random push of them is the intervention compared with temperature in the headline.</p>'},
 {key:'opening',name:'Opening',
  inn:'<p>Generation starts. Programs of both algorithms begin with the same text.</p>',
  done:'<p>Prefix resampling: continuations are resampled from prefixes of growing length and labelled, until the algorithm distribution jumps.</p>',
  out:'<p>A <button type="button" class="term" data-term="opening">shared opening</button> of <b>'+STEP.opening_len+' tokens</b>, written by '+pct(STEP.opening_cov)+' of programs:</p><pre>'+esc(STEP.opening)+'</pre>',
  why:'<p>Up to here nothing has decided the algorithm: Kruskal and Prim programs both open this way.</p>'},
 {key:'fork',name:'Fork',
  inn:'<p>The token after the comment marker <code>#</code> that ends the opening.</p>',
  done:'<p>Teacher-forced next-token probabilities at that position.</p>',
  out:'<div id="st-forkbars" class="chart"></div>',
  why:'<p>This is the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="fork">forking token</button>. Its probabilities set the mix of algorithms before a line of the algorithm is written.</p>'},
 {key:'branch',name:'Branches',
  inn:'<p>Each candidate fork token, forced in turn.</p>',
  done:'<p>'+kr.n+' continuations sampled at <i>T</i> = 1 from each forced token, and labelled by runtime behaviour.</p>',
  out:'<p><code>'+esc(kr.text)+'</code> leads to Kruskal in <b>'+pct(phat(kr,'kruskal'))+'</b> of continuations; <code>'+esc(prim.text)+'</code> leads to Prim in <b>'+pct(phat(prim,'prim_heap'))+'</b>. Remaining uncertainty <button type="button" class="term" data-term="hclass">H(A | class)</button> = '+fmt(STEP.H_bits,3)+' bits [95% CI '+fmt(STEP.H_ci[0],3)+', '+fmt(STEP.H_ci[1],3)+'].</p>',
  why:'<p>One token settles the algorithm, so temperature can change the algorithm only by changing which token is drawn here.</p>'},
 {key:'temp',name:'Temperature',
  inn:'<p>The tempered fork distribution and the tempered probability of reaching the opening, at <i>T</i> = 0.3, 0.7, 1.0 and 1.3.</p>',
  done:'<p>The <button type="button" class="term" data-term="law">composed law</button> combines them with the branch shares. It was committed before sampling, then checked on 100 fresh shared streams per temperature.</p>',
  out:'<div id="st-tempchart" class="chart"></div>',
  why:'<p>Here the fork is contested, so temperature moves the mix at the rate the logits predict. On the default tasks the same arithmetic leaves the alternative out of reach.</p>'},
 {key:'phr',name:'Phrasings',
  inn:'<p>The Kruskal programs of each temperature cell.</p>',
  done:'<p>Programs are grouped into <button type="button" class="term" data-term="phrasing">phrasing clusters</button> by AST 4-gram similarity.</p>',
  out:'<div id="st-phr"></div>',
  why:'<p>Temperature multiplies the surface forms of the same few ideas; it does not add ideas.</p>'}
];
var cur=0, stepperEl=document.getElementById('stepper');
function drawPipe(){
  var box=document.getElementById('pipe'); box.innerHTML='';
  var W=Math.max(300,box.clientWidth), n=STAGES.length, cols=W<560?4:n, rowsN=Math.ceil(n/cols);
  var gapX=W<560?10:14, bw=(W-gapX*(cols-1))/cols, bh=44, gapY=22, h=rowsN*bh+(rowsN-1)*gapY+4;
  var svg=S('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+h,width:W,height:h,role:'group','aria-label':'Pipeline stages'},box);
  STAGES.forEach(function(s,i){
    var r=Math.floor(i/cols), c=i%cols, x=c*(bw+gapX), y=r*(bh+gapY)+2, on=i===cur, past=i<cur;
    if(c<cols-1&&i<n-1) S('line',{x1:x+bw,x2:x+bw+gapX,y1:y+bh/2,y2:y+bh/2,stroke:past||on?'#1d5bbf':'#c3c9d1','stroke-width':2},svg);
    var g=S('g',{tabindex:0,role:'button','aria-label':'Stage '+(i+1)+' of '+n+': '+s.name,'class':'mark'},svg);
    if(on) g.setAttribute('aria-current','step');
    S('rect',{x:x+1,y:y,width:bw-2,height:bh,rx:8,fill:on?'#1d5bbf':(past?'#e9f0fb':'#fff'),stroke:on||past?'#1d5bbf':'#c3c9d1','stroke-width':1.5},g);
    var fs=Math.min(13,Math.max(10.5,bw/7.5));
    T(g,x+bw/2,y+bh/2-3,String(i+1),{'font-size':10.5,'text-anchor':'middle',fill:on?'#dbe6fa':'#5f6878'});
    T(g,x+bw/2,y+bh/2+11,s.name,{'font-size':fs,'text-anchor':'middle','font-weight':650,fill:on?'#fff':'#1b2029'});
    g.addEventListener('click',function(){go(i);});
    g.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault(); go(i);}});
  });
}
function drawForkBars(){
  var box=document.getElementById('st-forkbars'); if(!box)return; box.innerHTML='';
  var toks=STEP.fork_tokens.slice(0,4), W=Math.max(260,box.clientWidth), labW=Math.ceil(textW('token 9008',11))+10, padR=56, rowH=26, h=toks.length*rowH+30;
  var svg=S('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+h,width:W,height:h},box), x0=labW, x1=W-padR, sx=function(v){return x0+(x1-x0)*v;};
  [0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1].forEach(function(t){S('line',{x1:sx(t),x2:sx(t),y1:0,y2:h-24,stroke:'#eef0f2'},svg); T(svg,sx(t),h-12,fmt(t,2),{'font-size':10,'text-anchor':'middle'});});
  T(svg,(x0+x1)/2,h-1,'Teacher-forced probability at the fork (T = 1)',{'font-size':10.5,'text-anchor':'middle'});
  toks.forEach(function(t,i){var y=i*rowH+3, nm=t.text?('"'+t.text.trim()+'"'):('token '+t.tok), col=t.cls==='kruskal'?'#8b95a4':'#e69f00';
    T(svg,x0-6,y+14,nm,{'font-size':11,'text-anchor':'end'});
    var r=S('rect',{x:x0,y:y+3,width:Math.max(1,sx(t.pi)-x0),height:15,fill:col},svg);
    T(svg,Math.max(sx(t.pi),x0+2)+5,y+15,fmt(t.pi,t.pi>=0.01?2:4),{'font-size':11,'font-weight':700});
    mark(r,'<b>'+esc(nm)+'</b>: probability '+fmt(t.pi,4)+' at the fork; its forced continuations were Kruskal '+pct(phat(t,'kruskal'))+', Prim '+pct(phat(t,'prim_heap'))+' (n = '+t.n+')');});
}
function drawTempChart(){
  var box=document.getElementById('st-tempchart'); if(!box)return; box.innerHTML='';
  var W=Math.max(260,box.clientWidth), h=210, tl=Math.ceil(textW('0.30',10.5))+8, padL=tl+18, padB=40, padT=10, padR=10;
  var svg=S('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+h,width:W,height:h},box);
  var sx=function(t){return padL+(W-padL-padR)*(t-0.2)/(1.4-0.2);}, sy=function(v){return padT+(h-padT-padB)*(1-v/0.4);};
  [0,0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4].forEach(function(v){S('line',{x1:padL,x2:W-padR,y1:sy(v),y2:sy(v),stroke:'#eef0f2'},svg); T(svg,padL-5,sy(v)+3.5,fmt(v,2),{'font-size':10.5,'text-anchor':'end'});});
  STEP.temps.forEach(function(t){T(svg,sx(t.T),h-padB+15,fmt(t.T,1),{'font-size':10.5,'text-anchor':'middle'});});
  T(svg,(padL+W-padR)/2,h-6,'Sampling temperature T',{'font-size':11,'text-anchor':'middle'});
  var yt=T(svg,0,0,'Prim share',{'font-size':11,'text-anchor':'middle',transform:'translate(10,'+(padT+(h-padT-padB)/2)+') rotate(-90)'});
  var d=''; STEP.temps.forEach(function(t,i){d+=(i?'L':'M')+sx(t.T)+','+sy(t.pred);}); S('path',{d:d,fill:'none',stroke:'#1d5bbf','stroke-width':2.2},svg);
  STEP.temps.forEach(function(t){var c=S('circle',{cx:sx(t.T),cy:sy(t.obs),r:5.5,fill:'#1b2029'},svg);
    mark(c,'<b>T = '+fmt(t.T,1)+'</b><br>Observed Prim share '+fmt(t.obs,2)+' (of '+t.N+')<br>Composed law '+fmt(t.pred,3));
    var q=S('rect',{x:sx(t.T)-4,y:sy(t.pred)-4,width:8,height:8,fill:'#fff',stroke:'#1d5bbf','stroke-width':2},svg);
    mark(q,'<b>T = '+fmt(t.T,1)+'</b><br>Composed law, committed before sampling: '+fmt(t.pred,3));});
  var lg=H('ul',{'class':'legend'},'<li><span class="sw" style="background:#1b2029;border-radius:50%"></span>observed Prim share (100 streams per cell)</li><li><span class="sw" style="background:#fff;border:2px solid #1d5bbf"></span>composed law</li>');
  box.appendChild(lg);
  var a=STEP.temps[0], b=STEP.temps[STEP.temps.length-1];
  box.appendChild(H('p',{'class':'small'},'Prim rose from '+fmt(a.obs,2)+' at T 0.3 to '+fmt(b.obs,2)+' at T 1.3. Lowering T from 1.0 to 0.3 removed Prim in one direction only: '+STEP.drop.mcnemar_b_c[0]+':'+STEP.drop.mcnemar_b_c[1]+' discordant streams (one-sided <i>p</i> = '+fmtSci(STEP.drop.p_one_sided,1)+').'));
}
function drawPhr(){
  var box=document.getElementById('st-phr'); if(!box)return;
  var html='<div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Temperature</th><th>Kruskal programs</th><th>Kruskal phrasings</th><th>Prim programs</th><th>Prim phrasings</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  STEP.temps.forEach(function(t){html+='<tr><td>T '+fmt(t.T,1)+'</td><td>'+t.n_kr+'</td><td>'+t.phr_kr+'</td><td>'+t.n_pr+'</td><td>'+t.phr_pr+'</td></tr>';});
  html+='</tbody></table></div><p class="small" style="margin-top:.5rem">Ideas stay at the same two known algorithms in every cell while Kruskal phrasings grow from '+STEP.temps[0].phr_kr+' to '+STEP.temps[3].phr_kr+'.</p>';
  box.innerHTML=html;
}
function renderStage(){
  var s=STAGES[cur], body=document.getElementById('st-body');
  body.innerHTML='<h3 style="margin-top:.4rem">Stage '+(cur+1)+' of '+STAGES.length+': '+esc(s.name)+'</h3><div class="stage-panel">'+
    '<div class="io"><h4>What goes in</h4>'+s.inn+'</div><div class="io"><h4>What is done to it</h4>'+s.done+'</div>'+
    '<div class="io"><h4>What comes out</h4>'+s.out+'</div><div class="io"><h4>Why it matters</h4>'+s.why+'</div></div>';
  body.querySelectorAll('.term').forEach(wireTerm);
  document.getElementById('st-prev').disabled=cur===0; document.getElementById('st-next').disabled=cur===STAGES.length-1;
  document.getElementById('st-count').textContent='Stage '+(cur+1)+' of '+STAGES.length;
  document.getElementById('st-live').textContent='Stage '+(cur+1)+' of '+STAGES.length+': '+s.name;
  drawPipe(); drawForkBars(); drawTempChart(); drawPhr();
}
function go(i){cur=Math.max(0,Math.min(STAGES.length-1,i)); renderStage();}
document.getElementById('st-prev').addEventListener('click',function(){go(cur-1);});
document.getElementById('st-next').addEventListener('click',function(){go(cur+1);});
stepperEl.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){var tg=e.target; if(tg&&(tg.tagName==='INPUT'||tg.tagName==='SELECT'))return;
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault(); go(cur+1); focusCur();} else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault(); go(cur-1); focusCur();}});
function focusCur(){var g=document.querySelector('#pipe [aria-current="step"]'); if(g&&stepperEl.contains(document.activeElement)&&document.activeElement.closest('#pipe'))g.focus();}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 3a. law view */
var PREDS=[{k:'L',n:'Composed law',c:'#1d5bbf',dash:''},{k:'B0',n:'Flat law',c:'#6b7380',dash:'6 4'},{k:'B1',n:'Share tempering',c:'#e69f00',dash:'2 3'},{k:'B2',n:'Single fork law',c:'#009e73',dash:'8 3 2 3'},{k:'BH',n:'Highest-entropy position',c:'#cc79a7',dash:'1 2'}];
var law={unit:'B3',on:{L:true,B0:true,B1:false,B2:false,BH:false}};
var unitSel=document.getElementById('law-unit');
LAW.units.forEach(function(u){var o=H('option',{value:u.id},esc(u.name+' ('+u.model+(u.held_out?', held out':'')+')')); unitSel.appendChild(o);});
unitSel.value=law.unit; unitSel.addEventListener('change',function(){law.unit=unitSel.value; drawLaw();});
function lawLegend(){var c=document.getElementById('law-preds'); c.innerHTML='';
  PREDS.forEach(function(p){var b=H('button',{type:'button','class':'chip','aria-pressed':law.on[p.k]?'true':'false'},'<svg width="26" height="10" aria-hidden="true" style="vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px"><line x1="1" x2="25" y1="5" y2="5" stroke="'+p.c+'" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="'+p.dash+'"/></svg>'+esc(p.n));
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){law.on[p.k]=!law.on[p.k]; b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',law.on[p.k]?'true':'false'); drawLaw();}); c.appendChild(b);});
  var obs=H('span',{'class':'small'},'<svg width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true" style="vertical-align:middle"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="5" fill="#1b2029"/></svg> observed, with Wilson 95% interval');
  c.appendChild(obs);}
function unitById(id){return LAW.units.filter(function(u){return u.id===id;})[0];}
function drawLaw(){
  var u=unitById(law.unit), box=document.getElementById('law-chart'); box.innerHTML='';
  var W=Math.max(300,box.clientWidth), h=W<500?260:300;
  var ymax=0; u.cells.forEach(function(c){ymax=Math.max(ymax,c.wilson[1]); PREDS.forEach(function(p){if(law.on[p.k])ymax=Math.max(ymax,c.pred[p.k]);});});
  ymax=Math.min(1,Math.ceil((ymax+0.02)*10)/10);
  var ticks=niceTicks(0,ymax,5), tf=ticksFmt(ticks), tlw=Math.max.apply(null,ticks.map(function(t){return textW(tf(t),11);}));
  var padL=Math.ceil(tlw)+30, padR=12, padT=12, padB=44;
  var svg=S('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+h,width:W,height:h},box);
  var sx=function(t){return padL+(W-padL-padR)*(t-0.2)/(1.4-0.2);}, sy=function(v){return padT+(h-padT-padB)*(1-v/ymax);};
  ticks.forEach(function(v){S('line',{x1:padL,x2:W-padR,y1:sy(v),y2:sy(v),stroke:'#eef0f2'},svg); T(svg,padL-6,sy(v)+4,tf(v),{'font-size':11,'text-anchor':'end'});});
  S('line',{x1:padL,x2:W-padR,y1:sy(0),y2:sy(0),stroke:'#9aa3ae'},svg);
  u.cells.forEach(function(c){T(svg,sx(c.T),h-padB+17,fmt(c.T,1),{'font-size':11,'text-anchor':'middle'});});
  T(svg,(padL+W-padR)/2,h-8,'Sampling temperature T (top-p 1)',{'font-size':12,'text-anchor':'middle','font-weight':600});
  T(svg,0,0,'Share of '+u.minority,{'font-size':12,'text-anchor':'middle','font-weight':600,transform:'translate(13,'+(padT+(h-padT-padB)/2)+') rotate(-90)'});
  PREDS.forEach(function(p){if(!law.on[p.k])return; var d=''; u.cells.forEach(function(c,i){d+=(i?'L':'M')+sx(c.T)+','+sy(c.pred[p.k]);});
    S('path',{d:d,fill:'none',stroke:p.c,'stroke-width':p.k==='L'?2.6:2,'stroke-dasharray':p.dash},svg);
    u.cells.forEach(function(c){var m=S('circle',{cx:sx(c.T),cy:sy(c.pred[p.k]),r:4,fill:'#fff',stroke:p.c,'stroke-width':2},svg);
      mark(m,'<b>'+esc(p.n)+'</b> at T = '+fmt(c.T,1)+': predicted share '+fmt(c.pred[p.k],3));});});
  u.cells.forEach(function(c){var x=sx(c.T)+(W<500?0:0);
    S('line',{x1:x,x2:x,y1:sy(c.wilson[0]),y2:sy(c.wilson[1]),stroke:'#1b2029','stroke-width':1.6},svg);
    S('line',{x1:x-4,x2:x+4,y1:sy(c.wilson[0]),y2:sy(c.wilson[0]),stroke:'#1b2029','stroke-width':1.6},svg);
    S('line',{x1:x-4,x2:x+4,y1:sy(c.wilson[1]),y2:sy(c.wilson[1]),stroke:'#1b2029','stroke-width':1.6},svg);
    var o=S('circle',{cx:x,cy:sy(c.share),r:6,fill:'#1b2029'},svg);
    var parts=PREDS.filter(function(p){return law.on[p.k];}).map(function(p){return esc(p.n)+' '+fmt(c.pred[p.k],3);});
    mark(o,'<b>T = '+fmt(c.T,1)+'</b>: observed '+c.k+' of '+c.N+' ('+fmt(c.share,2)+'), Wilson 95% ['+fmt(c.wilson[0],2)+', '+fmt(c.wilson[1],2)+']<br>Pass rate '+fmt(c.pass,2)+(c.cap!==null&&c.cap!==undefined?'; programs hitting the token cap: '+c.cap:'')+(parts.length?'<br>'+parts.join('; '):''));});
  var best=PREDS.map(function(p){return p.k;}).reduce(function(a,b){return u.mae[b]<u.mae[a]?b:a;});
  var tk=document.getElementById('law-take');
  tk.innerHTML=esc(u.name)+' ('+esc(u.model)+(u.held_out?', held out':', development')+'): the composed law’s error is '+fmt(u.mae.L,3)+' against '+fmt(u.mae.B0,3)+' for the flat law, and the lowest error here belongs to the '+esc(PREDS.filter(function(p){return p.k===best;})[0].n.toLowerCase())+' ('+fmt(u.mae[best],3)+'). The unit '+(u.pass?'passes':'fails')+' its preregistered criterion (error at most 0.10 with H(A | class) at most 0.3 bits; here '+(u.H<0.001?'below 0.001':fmt(u.H,u.H<0.01?3:2))+' bits).';
  drawLawTable();
}
function drawLawTable(){
  var t=document.getElementById('law-table'); var cap=t.querySelector('caption');
  var html='<thead><tr><th scope="col">Unit (model)</th><th scope="col">Held out</th>'+PREDS.map(function(p){return '<th scope="col">'+esc(p.n)+'</th>';}).join('')+'<th scope="col">Pass</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  LAW.units.forEach(function(u){var best=Math.min.apply(null,PREDS.map(function(p){return Number(fmt(u.mae[p.k],3));}));
    html+='<tr tabindex="0" data-u="'+u.id+'" aria-selected="'+(u.id===law.unit?'true':'false')+'"><td>'+esc(u.name)+' ('+esc(u.model)+')</td><td>'+(u.held_out?'yes':'no')+'</td>'+
      PREDS.map(function(p){var s=fmt(u.mae[p.k],3); return '<td'+(Number(s)===best?' class="best"':'')+'>'+s+'</td>';}).join('')+'<td>'+(u.pass?'yes':'no')+'</td></tr>';});
  t.innerHTML=html+'</tbody>'; t.insertBefore(cap,t.firstChild);
  t.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach(function(tr){function pick(){law.unit=tr.dataset.u; unitSel.value=law.unit; drawLaw(); var n=document.querySelector('#law-table tr[data-u="'+law.unit+'"]'); if(n)n.focus();}
    tr.addEventListener('click',pick); tr.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault(); pick();}});});
}
lawLegend();

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 3b. program browser */
var br={task:'T2',cond:'push1',changed:true,fail:false,q:'',sel:null};
var COND_GROUPS=[{v:'all',n:'All conditions'},{v:'temp',n:'Temperature, thinking off'},{v:'think',n:'Temperature, thinking on'},{v:'sens',n:'Top-k 10 and min-p 0.1'},{v:'push1',n:'Push, α = 1'},{v:'push2',n:'Push, α = 2'}];
var bTask=document.getElementById('br-task'), bCond=document.getElementById('br-cond');
SEEDS.tasks.forEach(function(t){bTask.appendChild(H('option',{value:t.id},esc(t.name)));});
COND_GROUPS.forEach(function(g){bCond.appendChild(H('option',{value:g.v},esc(g.n)));});
bTask.value=br.task; bCond.value=br.cond;
function inGroup(c,g){var cd=SEEDS.conds.filter(function(x){return x.id===c;})[0]; if(!cd)return false; if(g==='all')return true;
  if(g==='push1')return cd.group==='push'&&cd.alpha===1; if(g==='push2')return cd.group==='push'&&cd.alpha===2; return cd.group===g;}
function items(){var out=[]; var q=br.q.trim().toLowerCase();
  SEEDS.rows[br.task].forEach(function(row){var base=row.cells['NOPN_T1.0'];
    SEEDS.conds.forEach(function(cd){var v=row.cells[cd.id]; if(!v||!inGroup(cd.id,br.cond))return;
      var changed=base&&v[0]!==base[0];
      if(br.changed&&!changed)return; if(br.fail&&v[1])return;
      if(q&&CODES[v[2]].toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0)return;
      out.push({row:row,c:cd.id,v:v,changed:changed});});});
  return out;}
function key(it){return br.task+'|'+it.row.w+'|'+it.row.i+'|'+it.c;}
function drawBrowser(){
  var list=document.getElementById('br-list'), its=items(); list.innerHTML='';
  var total=0, totalChanged=0, totalFail=0; SEEDS.rows[br.task].forEach(function(row){var base=row.cells['NOPN_T1.0']; SEEDS.conds.forEach(function(cd){var v=row.cells[cd.id]; if(v&&inGroup(cd.id,br.cond)){total++; if(base&&v[0]!==base[0])totalChanged++; if(!v[1])totalFail++;}});});
  document.getElementById('br-count').innerHTML='<span class="count">'+its.length+'</span> of '+total+' programs in this task and condition group match the filters.';
  if(!its.length){br.sel=null;} else if(!br.sel||!its.some(function(it){return key(it)===br.sel;})){br.sel=key(its[0]);}
  its.forEach(function(it){var l=SEEDS.labels[it.v[0]];
    var b=H('button',{type:'button','aria-current':key(it)===br.sel?'true':'false'},'<span class="sw" style="background:'+LCOL[l]+'"></span><span>Seed '+it.row.w+'·'+it.row.i+' · '+esc(condLabel(it.c).replace(' (also the unpushed arm)',''))+' · <b>'+esc(NAME[l]||l)+'</b>'+(it.v[1]?'':' · fails')+'</span>');
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){br.sel=key(it); drawBrowser();});
    var li=H('li'); li.appendChild(b); list.appendChild(li);});
  var det=document.getElementById('br-detail');
  var it=its.filter(function(x){return key(x)===br.sel;})[0];
  if(!it){det.innerHTML='<p class="small">No program matches. Clear the search or a filter.</p>';}
  else{var base=it.row.cells['NOPN_T1.0'], lb=SEEDS.labels[base[0]], l=SEEDS.labels[it.v[0]];
    function pane(title,v,lbl){return '<div class="pane"><h4>'+title+' <span class="tag" style="background:'+LCOL[lbl]+'33">'+esc(NAME[lbl]||lbl)+'</span> <span class="tag '+(v[1]?'pass':'fail')+'">'+(v[1]?'passes hidden tests':'fails hidden tests')+'</span></h4><pre class="code" tabindex="0">'+esc(CODES[v[2]])+'</pre></div>';}
    det.innerHTML='<details class="prompt"><summary>Input: the prompt for seed '+it.row.w+'·'+it.row.i+' (template '+it.row.w+')</summary><p>'+esc(SEEDS.prompts[br.task][it.row.w])+'</p></details>'+
      '<div class="panes" style="margin-top:.8rem">'+pane('Before: unpushed, T 1.0',base,lb)+pane('After: '+esc(condLabel(it.c).replace(' (also the unpushed arm)','')),it.v,l)+'</div>';}
  var tk=document.getElementById('br-take'), gname=COND_GROUPS.filter(function(g){return g.v===br.cond;})[0].n.toLowerCase();
  tk.textContent=TASKNAME[br.task]+', '+gname+': '+totalChanged+' of '+total+' programs use a different algorithm from the unpushed program of the same seed, and '+totalFail+' of '+total+' fail the hidden tests.'+(it?(' The selected program is '+(NAME[l]||l)+(lb===l?', the same algorithm as before.':(' where the same seed wrote '+(NAME[lb]||lb)+' without the push.'))):'');
}
function openInBrowser(task,c,row){br.task=task; bTask.value=task; var cd=SEEDS.conds.filter(function(x){return x.id===c;})[0];
  br.cond=cd.group==='push'?(cd.alpha===1?'push1':'push2'):cd.group; bCond.value=br.cond; br.changed=false; document.getElementById('br-changed').checked=false;
  br.fail=false; document.getElementById('br-fail').checked=false; br.q=''; document.getElementById('br-q').value='';
  br.sel=task+'|'+row.w+'|'+row.i+'|'+c; drawBrowser(); document.getElementById('br-card').scrollIntoView({behavior:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?'auto':'smooth',block:'start'});
  var cb=document.querySelector('#br-list [aria-current="true"]'); if(cb){cb.focus({preventScroll:true});}}
bTask.addEventListener('change',function(){br.task=bTask.value; br.sel=null; drawBrowser();});
bCond.addEventListener('change',function(){br.cond=bCond.value; br.sel=null; drawBrowser();});
document.getElementById('br-changed').addEventListener('change',function(e){br.changed=e.target.checked; drawBrowser();});
document.getElementById('br-fail').addEventListener('change',function(e){br.fail=e.target.checked; drawBrowser();});
document.getElementById('br-q').addEventListener('input',function(e){br.q=e.target.value; drawBrowser();});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 3c. margins */
var mg={fmt:'chat'};
function drawMargins(){
  var box=document.getElementById('mg-chart'); box.innerHTML='';
  var W=Math.max(300,box.clientWidth), tasks=MARG.tasks, vals=[];
  tasks.forEach(function(t){var d=t[mg.fmt]; vals=vals.concat(d.instr,d.base);});
  var lo=Math.min(0,Math.floor(Math.min.apply(null,vals))), hi=Math.ceil(Math.max.apply(null,vals)/2)*2;
  var ticks=niceTicks(lo,hi,6), tf=ticksFmt(ticks), padL=8, padR=14, rowH=74, top=4, axisH=42, bh=14;
  var h=top+tasks.length*rowH+axisH, x0=padL, x1=W-padR;
  var sx=function(v){return x0+(x1-x0)*(v-ticks[0])/(ticks[ticks.length-1]-ticks[0]);};
  var svg=S('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+h,width:W,height:h},box);
  ticks.forEach(function(t){S('line',{x1:sx(t),x2:sx(t),y1:top,y2:h-axisH+4,stroke:t===0?'#9aa3ae':'#eef0f2'},svg); T(svg,sx(t),h-axisH+18,tf(t),{'font-size':11,'text-anchor':'middle'});});
  T(svg,(x0+x1)/2,h-6,'Fork margin (nats), mean over five templates',{'font-size':12,'text-anchor':'middle','font-weight':600});
  function mean(a){return a.reduce(function(s,v){return s+v;},0)/a.length;}
  tasks.forEach(function(t,i){var d=t[mg.fmt], y=top+i*rowH;
    T(svg,x0,y+13,t.name+' ('+t.default+')'+(t.is_default?'':', mixed unit'),{'font-size':12,'font-weight':650,fill:'#1b2029'});
    T(svg,x1,y+13,'gain '+(d.gain>=0?'+':'')+fmt(d.gain,2),{'font-size':12,'font-weight':700,'text-anchor':'end',fill:'#1d4f91'});
    [['instr','#1d4f91','Qwen3-8B (instruct)'],['base','#a9b2be','Qwen3-8B-Base']].forEach(function(s,j){
      var arr=d[s[0]], m=mean(arr), by=y+20+j*(bh+6), a=Math.min(sx(0),sx(m)), b=Math.max(sx(0),sx(m));
      var r=S('rect',{'class':'bar',x:a,y:by,width:Math.max(1,b-a),height:bh,fill:s[1]},svg);
      var mn=Math.min.apply(null,arr), mx=Math.max.apply(null,arr);
      S('line',{x1:sx(mn),x2:sx(mx),y1:by+bh/2,y2:by+bh/2,stroke:'#1b2029','stroke-width':1.4},svg);
      S('line',{x1:sx(mn),x2:sx(mn),y1:by+3,y2:by+bh-3,stroke:'#1b2029','stroke-width':1.4},svg); S('line',{x1:sx(mx),x2:sx(mx),y1:by+3,y2:by+bh-3,stroke:'#1b2029','stroke-width':1.4},svg);
      mark(r,'<b>'+esc(t.name)+'</b>, '+s[2]+(mg.fmt==='chat'?', chat template':', without chat tokens')+'<br>Mean fork margin '+fmt(m,2)+' nats; templates '+fmt(mn,2)+' to '+fmt(mx,2));});});
  var dflt=tasks.filter(function(t){return t.is_default;}), g=dflt.map(function(t){return (t[mg.fmt].gain>=0?'+':'')+fmt(t[mg.fmt].gain,2);});
  var tk=document.getElementById('mg-take');
  if(mg.fmt==='chat'){var dh=tasks.map(function(t){return t.dH;}), dmin=Math.min.apply(null,dh), dmax=Math.max.apply(null,dh);
    var ur=dflt.map(function(t){var n=0,k=0; for(var key in t.urial_phr){n+=t.urial_phr[key]; if(key==='1')k=t.urial_phr[key];} return k/n;});
    tk.textContent='With the chat template, post-training widened the fork margin on the three default tasks by '+g.join(', ')+' nats. At ordinary phrasing positions the base model’s next-token entropy is only '+fmt(dmin,2)+' to '+fmt(dmax,2)+' nats higher, and the instruct token is the base model’s top token at '+fmt(100*Math.min.apply(null,ur),1)+'% to '+fmt(100*Math.max.apply(null,ur),1)+'% of phrasing positions on the default tasks.';}
  else tk.textContent='Without chat tokens the gains on the default tasks are '+g.join(', ')+' nats, so the chat template does not produce them.';
}
seg(document.getElementById('mg-fmt'),'radiogroup',[{v:'chat',label:'Chat template'},{v:'free',label:'Without chat tokens'}],mg.fmt,function(v){mg.fmt=v; drawMargins();});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 3d. geometry */
var ALG={bfs:'BFS',dfs:'DFS',iddfs:'IDDFS',astar:'A*',gbfs:'greedy best-first',bibfs:'bidirectional BFS',dijkstra_unit:'unit-weight Dijkstra',idastar:'IDA*',jps:'jump point search',biastar:'bidirectional A*'};
var ACOL={bfs:'#332288',dfs:'#88ccee',iddfs:'#44aa99',astar:'#117733',gbfs:'#999933',bibfs:'#ddcc77',dijkstra_unit:'#cc3311',idastar:'#882255',jps:'#aa4499',biastar:'#6b7380'};
var geo={ov:{baseline:false,ban:true,confirm:true},pts:'all'};
var ALGS=['bfs','dfs','iddfs','astar','gbfs','bibfs','dijkstra_unit','idastar','jps','biastar'];
function centroids(){var c={}; ALGS.forEach(function(a){c[a]=[0,0,0];}); GEO.points.forEach(function(p,i){var a=GEO.point_labels[i]; if(c[a]){c[a][0]+=p[0]; c[a][1]+=p[1]; c[a][2]++;}});
  ALGS.forEach(function(a){if(c[a][2]){c[a][0]/=c[a][2]; c[a][1]/=c[a][2];}}); return c;}
function drawGeo(){
  var box=document.getElementById('geo-chart'); box.innerHTML='';
  var W=Math.max(300,box.clientWidth), h=Math.round(Math.min(560,Math.max(320,W*0.62)));
  var xs=GEO.points.map(function(p){return p[0];}), ys=GEO.points.map(function(p){return p[1];});
  ['baseline','ban','confirm'].forEach(function(k){GEO.overlays[k].pca.forEach(function(p){xs.push(p[0]); ys.push(p[1]);});});
  var xl=Math.min.apply(null,xs), xh=Math.max.apply(null,xs), yl=Math.min.apply(null,ys), yh=Math.max.apply(null,ys);
  var xt=niceTicks(xl,xh,6), yt=niceTicks(yl,yh,5); xl=Math.min(xl,xt[0]); xh=Math.max(xh,xt[xt.length-1]); yl=Math.min(yl,yt[0]); yh=Math.max(yh,yt[yt.length-1]);
  var tfx=ticksFmt(xt), tfy=ticksFmt(yt), tlw=Math.max.apply(null,yt.map(function(t){return textW(tfy(t),11);}));
  var padL=Math.ceil(tlw)+32, padR=10, padT=10, padB=44;
  var sx=function(v){return padL+(W-padL-padR)*(v-xl)/(xh-xl);}, sy=function(v){return padT+(h-padT-padB)*(1-(v-yl)/(yh-yl));};
  var svg=S('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+h,width:W,height:h},box);
  xt.forEach(function(t){S('line',{x1:sx(t),x2:sx(t),y1:padT,y2:h-padB,stroke:'#eef0f2'},svg); T(svg,sx(t),h-padB+16,tfx(t),{'font-size':11,'text-anchor':'middle'});});
  yt.forEach(function(t){S('line',{x1:padL,x2:W-padR,y1:sy(t),y2:sy(t),stroke:'#eef0f2'},svg); T(svg,padL-6,sy(t)+4,tfy(t),{'font-size':11,'text-anchor':'end'});});
  T(svg,(padL+W-padR)/2,h-8,'Principal component 1 ('+pct(GEO.evr[0])+' of variance; activation units)',{'font-size':12,'text-anchor':'middle','font-weight':600});
  T(svg,0,0,'Principal component 2 ('+pct(GEO.evr[1])+')',{'font-size':12,'text-anchor':'middle','font-weight':600,transform:'translate(13,'+(padT+(h-padT-padB)/2)+') rotate(-90)'});
  var banned={}; GEO.banned.forEach(function(a){banned[a]=1;});
  if(geo.pts==='all') GEO.points.forEach(function(p,i){var a=GEO.point_labels[i], x=sx(p[0]), y=sy(p[1]);
    if(banned[a]){S('path',{d:'M'+(x-3)+','+(y-3)+'L'+(x+3)+','+(y+3)+'M'+(x-3)+','+(y+3)+'L'+(x+3)+','+(y-3),stroke:ACOL[a],'stroke-width':1.6,opacity:.55},svg);}
    else S('circle',{cx:x,cy:y,r:2.8,fill:ACOL[a],opacity:.55},svg);});
  var C=centroids();
  ALGS.forEach(function(a){var x=sx(C[a][0]), y=sy(C[a][1]), n=GEO.ban_comp[a]||0, g=S('g',null,svg);
    if(a==='dijkstra_unit') S('circle',{cx:x,cy:y,r:13,fill:'none',stroke:'#1b2029','stroke-width':3},g);
    if(a==='bfs') S('circle',{cx:x,cy:y,r:12,fill:'none',stroke:'#1b2029','stroke-width':1.2},g);
    if(banned[a]) S('path',{d:'M'+(x-7)+','+(y-7)+'L'+(x+7)+','+(y+7)+'M'+(x-7)+','+(y+7)+'L'+(x+7)+','+(y-7),stroke:ACOL[a],'stroke-width':4},g);
    else S('circle',{cx:x,cy:y,r:7,fill:ACOL[a],stroke:'#fff','stroke-width':1.5},g);
    var lbl=ALG[a]+(n?' · '+n+'/'+GEO.ban_n:'');
    var tw=textW(lbl,11,650), lx=Math.min(W-padR-tw-2,Math.max(padL+2,x+11)), ly=y-10;
    T(g,lx,ly,lbl,{'font-size':11,'font-weight':650,fill:'#1b2029',stroke:'#fff','stroke-width':3,'paint-order':'stroke'});
    var cls=GEO.classes_k15[a];
    mark(g,'<b>'+esc(ALG[a])+'</b> ('+(banned[a]?'banned':'not banned')+')<br>Programs under the ban: '+n+' of '+GEO.ban_n+(a==='bfs'?'<br>Without the ban: '+(GEO.base_comp.bfs||0)+' of '+GEO.base_n+' programs':'')+(cls?'<br>Geodesic class on this map (k = 15): '+cls.toLowerCase():''));});
  var OV={baseline:['neutral prompts','#1b2029','tri'],ban:['ban prompts W1 to W3','#cc3311','dia'],confirm:['held-out ban prompts','#cc3311','diao']};
  Object.keys(OV).forEach(function(k){if(!geo.ov[k])return; var o=GEO.overlays[k];
    o.pca.forEach(function(p,i){var x=sx(p[0]), y=sy(p[1]), sh;
      if(OV[k][2]==='tri') sh=S('path',{d:'M'+x+','+(y-7)+'L'+(x+6)+','+(y+5)+'L'+(x-6)+','+(y+5)+'Z',fill:'#1b2029',stroke:'#fff','stroke-width':1},svg);
      else sh=S('path',{d:'M'+x+','+(y-8)+'L'+(x+7)+','+y+'L'+x+','+(y+8)+'L'+(x-7)+','+y+'Z',fill:OV[k][2]==='dia'?'#cc3311':'#fff',stroke:'#cc3311','stroke-width':2},svg);
      mark(sh,'<b>'+OV[k][0]+'</b>, template '+esc(o.templates[i]));});});
  var lg=document.getElementById('geo-legend'); lg.innerHTML='';
  ALGS.forEach(function(a){lg.appendChild(H('li',null,(banned[a]?'<svg width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2,2L12,12M2,12L12,2" stroke="'+ACOL[a]+'" stroke-width="3"/></svg>':'<span class="sw" style="background:'+ACOL[a]+';border-radius:50%"></span>')+esc(ALG[a])+(banned[a]?' (banned)':'')));});
  lg.appendChild(H('li',null,'<svg width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#1b2029" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg>thick ring: unit-weight Dijkstra, the unbanned algorithm written under the ban'));
  var pl=GEO.placement, tk=document.getElementById('geo-take'), parts=[];
  if(geo.ov.ban||geo.ov.confirm){var k=geo.ov.ban?'ban':'confirm'; parts.push('The '+(k==='ban'?'ban prompts':'held-out ban prompts')+' sit nearest '+ALG[pl[k].nearest_order[0]]+' and '+ALG[pl[k].nearest_order[1]]+', and unit-weight Dijkstra is the farthest of the ten centroids from them (rank '+pl[k].rank_udij+' of 10).');}
  if(geo.ov.baseline) parts.push('The neutral prompts sit nearest '+ALG[pl.baseline.nearest_order[0]]+' and '+ALG[pl.baseline.nearest_order[1]]+'.');
  parts.push('Under the ban the one correct catalogue survivor is unit-weight Dijkstra ('+(GEO.ban_comp.dijkstra_unit||0)+' of '+GEO.ban_n+' programs). On this map built from named prompts it lies opposite the banned set ('+fmt(GEO.ratio_named_e46,2)+' times the median geodesic distance); on a map built from name-scrubbed programs it lies at the edge ('+fmt(GEO.ratio_program,2)+' times, nearest '+ALG[GEO.nearest_banned_program]+'). The two maps disagree, and the geometry is correlational.');
  tk.textContent=parts.join(' ');
}
chipToggle(document.getElementById('geo-ov'),[{v:'baseline',label:'Neutral prompts'},{v:'ban',label:'Ban prompts'},{v:'confirm',label:'Held-out ban prompts'}],function(k){return geo.ov[k];},function(k,on){geo.ov[k]=on; drawGeo();});
seg(document.getElementById('geo-pts'),'radiogroup',[{v:'all',label:'Show all 300'},{v:'cent',label:'Centroids only'}],geo.pts,function(v){geo.pts=v; drawGeo();});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 4. what-if */
var wi={task:'T2',T:1.3,scale:'log'};
var wSel=document.getElementById('wi-task');
WHAT.tasks.forEach(function(t){wSel.appendChild(H('option',{value:t.id},esc(t.name+(t.kind==='default'?' (default '+t.default+')':' (mixed: '+t.default+' or '+t.minority+')'))));});
wSel.value=wi.task;
var scaleCtl=seg(document.getElementById('wi-scale'),'radiogroup',[{v:'log',label:'Logarithmic'},{v:'lin',label:'Linear'}],wi.scale,function(v){wi.scale=v; drawWhat();});
wSel.addEventListener('change',function(){wi.task=wSel.value; var t=wt(); wi.scale=t.kind==='default'?'log':'lin'; scaleCtl.set(wi.scale,false); drawWhat();});
var slider=document.getElementById('wi-T'), sOut=document.getElementById('wi-Tout');
slider.addEventListener('input',function(){wi.T=Number(slider.value); drawWhat();});
function wt(){return WHAT.tasks.filter(function(t){return t.id===wi.task;})[0];}
function closed(m,T){return 1/(1+Math.exp(m/T));}
function drawWhat(){
  var t=wt(), box=document.getElementById('wi-chart'); box.innerHTML=''; sOut.textContent=fmt(wi.T,2); slider.setAttribute('aria-valuetext','T = '+fmt(wi.T,2));
  var W=Math.max(300,box.clientWidth), h=W<500?250:290, isLog=wi.scale==='log';
  var lo=isLog?-12:0, hi=isLog?0:0.6, yt=isLog?[-12,-10,-8,-6,-4,-2,0]:niceTicks(0,0.6,6);
  var tf=isLog?function(v){return v===0?'1':'10'+'⁻'+String(-v).split('').map(function(c){return '⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹'[Number(c)];}).join('');}:ticksFmt(yt);
  var tlw=Math.max.apply(null,yt.map(function(v){return textW(tf(v),11);})), padL=Math.ceil(tlw)+32, padR=12, padT=10, padB=44;
  var sx=function(T){return padL+(W-padL-padR)*(T-0.1)/(3-0.1);};
  var sy=function(v){var y=isLog?Math.log10(Math.max(v,1e-12)):v; y=Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,y)); return padT+(h-padT-padB)*(1-(y-lo)/(hi-lo));};
  var svg=S('svg',{viewBox:'0 0 '+W+' '+h,width:W,height:h},box);
  yt.forEach(function(v){var yy=padT+(h-padT-padB)*(1-(v-lo)/(hi-lo)); S('line',{x1:padL,x2:W-padR,y1:yy,y2:yy,stroke:'#eef0f2'},svg); T(svg,padL-6,yy+4,tf(v),{'font-size':11,'text-anchor':'end'});});
  [0.3,0.7,1,1.3,2,3].forEach(function(T0){S('line',{x1:sx(T0),x2:sx(T0),y1:padT,y2:h-padB,stroke:'#f2f3f5'},svg); T(svg,sx(T0),h-padB+16,fmt(T0,1),{'font-size':11,'text-anchor':'middle'});});
  T(svg,(padL+W-padR)/2,h-8,'Sampling temperature T',{'font-size':12,'text-anchor':'middle','font-weight':600});
  T(svg,0,0,t.kind==='default'?'Share off the default':'Share of '+t.minority,{'font-size':12,'text-anchor':'middle','font-weight':600,transform:'translate(13,'+(padT+(h-padT-padB)/2)+') rotate(-90)'});
  var d=''; for(var i=0;i<=290;i++){var T0=0.1+i*0.01; d+=(i?'L':'M')+sx(T0).toFixed(1)+','+sy(closed(t.margin,T0)).toFixed(1);} S('path',{d:d,fill:'none',stroke:'#1d5bbf','stroke-width':2.4},svg);
  var pT=closed(t.margin,wi.T);
  S('line',{x1:sx(wi.T),x2:sx(wi.T),y1:padT,y2:h-padB,stroke:'#1d5bbf','stroke-dasharray':'4 3'},svg);
  var cur=S('circle',{cx:sx(wi.T),cy:sy(pT),r:6.5,fill:'#1d5bbf',stroke:'#fff','stroke-width':2},svg);
  mark(cur,'<b>T = '+fmt(wi.T,2)+'</b>: two-token closed form '+(pT<1e-4?fmtSci(pT,1):fmt(pT,4)));
  var lg=document.getElementById('wi-legend'); lg.innerHTML='<li><span class="sw" style="background:#1d5bbf;height:3px"></span>two-token closed form, margin '+fmt(t.margin,2)+' nats</li>';
  if(t.kind==='default'){
    ['0.3','0.7','1.0','1.3'].forEach(function(k){var v=t.pred_top20[k], q=S('rect',{x:sx(Number(k))-5,y:sy(v)-5,width:10,height:10,fill:'#fff',stroke:'#e69f00','stroke-width':2.2},svg);
      mark(q,'<b>T = '+k+'</b>: the run’s prediction over the top 20 fork tokens, '+(v<1e-4?fmtSci(v,1):fmt(v,4))+' off the default');});
    lg.innerHTML+='<li><span class="sw" style="background:#fff;border:2px solid #e69f00"></span>prediction over the top 20 fork tokens (recorded at four temperatures)</li>';
    var obsTxt=t.obs_T13.k+' of '+t.obs_T13.n+' samples drawn from the fork at T 1.3 left the default';
    var ob=S('text',{x:sx(1.3)+6,y:h-padB-6,'font-size':11,fill:'#1b2029','font-weight':650},svg); ob.textContent='observed at T 1.3: '+t.obs_T13.k+'/'+t.obs_T13.n;
    var need=t.margin/Math.log(9);
    document.getElementById('wi-take').innerHTML=esc(t.name)+': the fork margin is '+fmt(t.margin,2)+' nats. At T = '+fmt(wi.T,2)+' the two-token closed form puts '+(pT<1e-4?fmtSci(pT,1):fmt(pT,4))+' of samples off '+esc(t.default)+'; the run’s top-20 prediction at T 1.3 is '+(t.pred_top20['1.3']<1e-4?fmtSci(t.pred_top20['1.3'],1):fmt(t.pred_top20['1.3'],4))+', and '+obsTxt+'. Under the closed form, a tenth of samples would leave the default only at T = '+fmt(need,2)+'.';

Every chart below is drawn from the run's own labelled programs, so you can check for yourself whether temperature changes <em>which algorithm</em> Qwen3-8B writes, or only how it spells the same one.</p>\n    <ul class=\"links\">\n      <li><a class=\"btn btn-primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-295f8e-prompt-bans-substitute-not-just-subtract@fork/run_jSassd-YWLVC/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a></li>\n      <li><a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-295f8e-prompt-bans-substitute-not-just-subtract@fork/run_jSassd-YWLVC/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a></li>\n      <li><a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-295f8e-prompt-bans-substitute-not-just-subtract/tree/fork/run_jSassd-YWLVC\">Code repository</a></li>\n    </ul>\n  </div>\n</header>\n<nav class=\"secnav\" aria-label=\"Sections\">\n  <ul>\n    <li><a href=\"#finding\">The finding</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#how\">How it works</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#evidence\">Evidence</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#try\">Try it</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#fails\">Where it fails</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#about\">Sources and glossary</a></li>\n  </ul>\n</nav>\n<main id=\"main\">\n\n<!-- ============================== THE FINDING ============================== -->\n<section id=\"finding\" aria-labelledby=\"h-finding\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-finding\">The finding</h2>\n  <div class=\"finding-grid\">\n    <div class=\"prose\">\n      <p class=\"q\">Does raising the sampling temperature make a code model try a different algorithm?</p>\n      <p>Not on the tasks where it has a default. The run holds one stream of random numbers fixed per seed (<button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"crn\">common random numbers</button>) and labels every program by what it does when run on hidden tests. On those streams, temperature from 0.3 to 1.3 changed the algorithm in <span data-k=\"tempzero\"></span> seeds on each of three tasks. A <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"push\">random task-state push</button>, one random direction added to the <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"spec\">task specification states</button>, changed it in more seeds than temperature did, by</p>\n      <p class=\"bignum\" data-k=\"pooled_mean\"></p>\n      <p>changed seeds per seed, pooled over shortest path and <i>k</i>-th smallest (95% CI <span data-k=\"pooled_ci\"></span>; one-sided sign-flip <i>p</i> = <span data-k=\"pooled_p\"></span>, <span data-k=\"pooled_n\"></span> seeds).</p>\n      <p class=\"small\">The contrast was preregistered and held. The experiment around it is graded <span data-k=\"verdict\"></span>, because the push fell short of its predicted effect on <i>k</i>-th smallest, and it ran only in an 8-bit (W8A8) engine; the paired contrast is untested in bfloat16. Permuting conditions within each seed never reached the observed mean (maximum placebo mean <span data-k=\"placebo\"></span> in <span data-k=\"placebo_reps\"></span> permutations).</p>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"card\" id=\"headline-card\" style=\"margin-top:0\">\n      <p class=\"q\">On the same 20 seeds, which control changes the algorithm?</p>\n      <div class=\"controls\">\n        <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\" id=\"lab-hl-task\">Task</span>\n          <div class=\"seg\" role=\"tablist\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-hl-task\" id=\"hl-task\"></div></div>\n        <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\" id=\"lab-hl-temp\">Temperature arm</span>\n          <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-hl-temp\" id=\"hl-temp\"></div></div>\n        <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\" id=\"lab-hl-alpha\">Push size</span>\n          <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-hl-alpha\" id=\"hl-alpha\"></div></div>\n        <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\" id=\"lab-hl-dirs\">Push directions in the union</span>\n          <div class=\"chips\" role=\"group\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-hl-dirs\" id=\"hl-dirs\"></div></div>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"hl-matrix\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Seed by condition matrix of algorithm labels\"></div>\n      <ul class=\"legend\" id=\"hl-legend\"></ul>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"hl-bars\" style=\"margin-top:1rem\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Seeds whose algorithm changed, by control\"></div>\n      <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"hl-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n      <p class=\"note\">Each row is one seed (template · slot). A row is marked changed when its label differs anywhere across the columns of a block. The T 1.0 column is also the unpushed arm that each push column is compared with. Point at any cell to read its record, or press Enter on it to open the program in the browser below. Source: experiment 21, <code>data/labels.jsonl</code> and <code>results/c1seed.json</code>.</p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================== HOW IT WORKS ============================== -->\n<section id=\"how\" aria-labelledby=\"h-how\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-how\">How it works: one prompt, followed to its algorithm</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose\">The account in the paper is that the algorithm is settled at one or two <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"fork\">forking tokens</button> early in the program, and that temperature reaches the choice only through the next-token distribution there. Step through one real example, the minimum spanning tree task in Qwen3-8B, with the values the run recorded at each stage.</p>\n  <div class=\"card stepper\" id=\"stepper\">\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"pipe\" aria-hidden=\"false\"></div>\n    <div class=\"stage-nav\">\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"st-prev\">Previous stage</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"st-next\">Next stage</button>\n      <span class=\"small\" id=\"st-count\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></span>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"sr-only\" aria-live=\"polite\" id=\"st-live\"></p>\n    <div id=\"st-body\"></div>\n    <p class=\"note\">Use the stage markers, the buttons, or the left and right arrow keys while the stepper has focus. Sources: experiment 35 (<code>results/forks.json</code>, <code>results/predictions_view.json</code>, <code>results/s4b.json</code>), experiment 43 (<code>results/analysis_L.json</code>), and the prompt text from experiment 26 (<code>data/prompts.jsonl</code>, matched by SHA-256 to the prompt experiment 35 used).</p>\n  </div>\n  <figure>\n    <img src=\"figures/fig2_v0.jpg\" alt=\"Schematic of the account: a prompt about a minimum spanning tree, with the task words highlighted as task-specification states, leads to a 61-token shared opening, then a forking token where the chip Kr (probability 0.72) leads to Kruskal and the chip Prim (0.27) leads to Prim; a thermometer marks that temperature changes the algorithm only at the fork, and fans of lines show many phrasings per idea.\" width=\"1600\" height=\"900\" loading=\"lazy\">\n    <figcaption><b>Figure 2 of the paper.</b> Schematic illustration of the account and of the measurements (not data), using one minimum-spanning-tree example. <details><summary>Full caption</summary>Left to right: a rounded 'Prompt' box contains the task text 'Return the total weight of a minimum spanning tree of the graph.', with the task-defining words 'minimum spanning tree of the graph.' highlighted in light blue and bracketed as 'task-specification states (residual stream, blocks 12 to 23)'; two downward arrows above the box, labelled 'task-state exchange' and 'random task-state push', denote interventions applied to these states. An arrow leads to the 'shared opening (61 tokens)', shown as three representative monospace code tokens ('import heapq', 'graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]', '#') followed by an ellipsis marking the rest of the shared opening. A second arrow leads to a 'forking token' node, above which a thermometer icon is labelled 'temperature T: softmax(logits / T)' with the note 'changes the algorithm only here'. From the forking token, two branches lead to the token chips 'Kr' and 'Prim'; the orange bar beside each chip shows the token's probability at the fork: 0.72 for 'Kr', leading to the 'Kruskal' outcome box, and 0.27 for 'Prim', leading to the 'Prim' outcome box, with each bar's fill proportional to its value. A fan of four thin lines labelled 'phrasings' beside each outcome box denotes that one algorithmic idea is written out in many surface forms. A grey band spanning the bottom states the composed law 'P_T(A) = sum over openings w_T(O) x sum over forking tokens pi_T(t | O) x P(A | t)'. Blue marks the prompt-to-fork pipeline (boxes, arrows, the forking-token node and chips); orange marks the two realized algorithm outcomes and their fork probabilities. The 61-token opening length and the 0.72/0.27 fork split are the only numbers in the figure, drawn from teacher-forced measurements on this example; the diagram as a whole is a schematic of the proposed mechanism, not a plotted dataset.</details></figcaption>\n  </figure>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================== EVIDENCE ============================== -->\n<section id=\"evidence\" aria-labelledby=\"h-evidence\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-evidence\">Explore the evidence</h2>\n\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"law-card\">\n    <h3>Does the forking-token law predict temperature on every unit?</h3>\n    <p class=\"q\">Where the fork is contested, does a law built from its logits, committed before sampling, track how the minority algorithm moves with temperature?</p>\n    <p class=\"small prose\">The <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"law\">composed law</button> uses only teacher-forced logits and the shares of continuations forced from each fork token. Each <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"unit\">unit</button> was then swept on 100 fresh shared streams per temperature. The error is the <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"mae\">mean absolute error</button> over the four temperatures.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label class=\"lab\" for=\"law-unit\">Unit</label><select id=\"law-unit\"></select></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\" id=\"lab-law-pred\">Predictors drawn (the legend is the switch)</span>\n        <div class=\"chips\" role=\"group\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-law-pred\" id=\"law-preds\"></div></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"law-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Minority share against temperature, observed and predicted\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"law-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <h4 style=\"margin-top:1rem\">Mean absolute error of every predictor (top-<i>p</i> 1; lowest per row in bold; select a row to plot it)</h4>\n    <div class=\"tablewrap\"><table id=\"law-table\"><caption class=\"sr-only\">Mean absolute error of the composed law and four rivals per unit</caption></table></div>\n    <p class=\"note\">Source: experiment 43, <code>results/analysis_L.json</code>. Observed points carry Wilson 95% intervals; predicted values are the committed predictions stored in the file.</p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"br-card\">\n    <h3>What does a push do to one program?</h3>\n    <p class=\"q\">Put a pushed program beside the program the same seed wrote without the push. What changed?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label class=\"lab\" for=\"br-task\">Task</label><select id=\"br-task\"></select></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label class=\"lab\" for=\"br-cond\">Conditions</label><select id=\"br-cond\"></select></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label class=\"lab\" for=\"br-q\">Search the code</label><input type=\"search\" id=\"br-q\" placeholder=\"for example heapq or deque\" autocomplete=\"off\"></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\">Filters</span>\n        <label class=\"check\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"br-changed\" checked> Only programs whose algorithm differs from the unpushed program of the same seed</label>\n        <label class=\"check\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"br-fail\"> Only programs that fail the hidden tests</label></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"small\" id=\"br-count\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <div class=\"browser\">\n      <ul class=\"list\" id=\"br-list\" aria-label=\"Matching programs\"></ul>\n      <div id=\"br-detail\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"br-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Source: experiment 21, <code>data/labels.jsonl</code> (code and runtime labels for every program in the conditions shown; identical programs are stored once) and <code>prompts/prompts.jsonl</code> (the neutral-twin prompt each seed used).</p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"mg-card\">\n    <h3>Did post-training make the fork?</h3>\n    <p class=\"q\">On identical token ids, how far apart are the instruct and base models at the forking token?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\" id=\"lab-mg-fmt\">Prompt format</span>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-mg-fmt\" id=\"mg-fmt\"></div></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"mg-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Fork margin of instruct and base model per task\"></div>\n    <ul class=\"legend\"><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:#1d4f91\"></span>Qwen3-8B (instruct)</li><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:#a9b2be\"></span>Qwen3-8B-Base</li><li><span class=\"sw\" style=\"background:#fff;border-color:#333;border-width:1px;width:18px;height:2px\"></span>whisker: minimum to maximum over five prompt templates</li></ul>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"mg-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">The <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"margin\">fork margin</button> is a teacher-forced log-probability gap in nats. Source: experiment 43, <code>results/base_subarm.json</code>.</p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"geo-card\">\n    <h3>Where does a ban of five names land in activation space?</h3>\n    <p class=\"q\">When the five most common grid algorithms are banned by name, does the model move to an algorithm at the edge of the banned set or opposite it?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\" id=\"lab-geo-ov\">Prompt states drawn on the map</span>\n        <div class=\"chips\" role=\"group\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-geo-ov\" id=\"geo-ov\"></div></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\" id=\"lab-geo-pts\">Forced prompts</span>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-geo-pts\" id=\"geo-pts\"></div></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"geo-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Activation-space map of ten grid algorithms\"></div>\n    <ul class=\"legend\" id=\"geo-legend\"></ul>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"geo-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Points are the first two principal components of Qwen3-32B (4-bit weights, thinking mode) residual states at block <span data-k=\"geo_block\"></span>, averaged over the task tokens of 300 forced <code>Implement &lt;algorithm&gt;</code> prompts (30 per algorithm); the axes carry <span data-k=\"geo_evr\"></span> of the variance. Centroids are the means of each algorithm's points. Source: experiment 44, <code>results/geometry_M1.json</code>, <code>results/landing.json</code> and <code>data/labelled_C6_ban.jsonl</code>; program-map ratio from experiment 46, <code>results/geometry_32b_mcode_PRIMARY_R1.json</code>.</p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================== TRY IT ============================== -->\n<section id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-try\">Try it: how hot would temperature have to be?</h2>\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"wi-card\">\n    <p class=\"q\">Temperature divides the logits by <i>T</i>. Given the recorded fork margin, how much of the output leaves the default at a temperature of your choosing?</p>\n    <p class=\"small prose\">The curve is the run's own two-token closed form, the share off the default when only the two leading fork tokens compete: 1 / (1 + e<sup><i>m</i>/<i>T</i></sup>) for a margin of <i>m</i> nats. It is a simplification the run recorded beside its fuller prediction over the top 20 fork tokens; both are drawn. It ignores the opening, so it is not the composed law.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label class=\"lab\" for=\"wi-task\">Task or unit</label><select id=\"wi-task\"></select></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><label class=\"lab\" for=\"wi-T\">Temperature <i>T</i>: <output class=\"valout\" id=\"wi-Tout\" for=\"wi-T\"></output></label><input type=\"range\" id=\"wi-T\" min=\"0.1\" max=\"3\" step=\"0.05\" value=\"1.3\"></div>\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\" id=\"lab-wi-scale\">Vertical scale</span>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-wi-scale\" id=\"wi-scale\"></div></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"wi-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Share off the default against temperature\"></div>\n    <ul class=\"legend\" id=\"wi-legend\"></ul>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"wi-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">Sources: experiment 35, <code>results/predictions_view.json</code> (margins, closed form and top-20 predictions; fork-token probabilities for the mixed units) and <code>results/test3.json</code> (samples drawn from the fork at <i>T</i> 1.3); observed shares of the mixed units from experiment 43, <code>results/analysis_L.json</code>.</p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================== FAILS ============================== -->\n<section id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-fails\">Where it fails</h2>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <h3>The law misses when the decision is spread over many openings</h3>\n    <p class=\"q\">Which unit does the composed law fail on, and why?</p>\n    <p class=\"prose\">On Llama-3.1-8B's grid task every predictor fails. Llama reaches the forking tokens through many openings, so the committed law is almost the flat law, and at high temperature the programs collapse into unusable code.</p>\n    <p><button type=\"button\" class=\"btn\" id=\"fail-llama\">Show the Llama grid unit in the law view</button></p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"fail-llama-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"card\" id=\"ban-card\">\n    <h3>A ban of five names is mostly not obeyed</h3>\n    <p class=\"q\">Across ten open model configurations, how often does a ban of BFS, DFS, IDDFS, A* and greedy best-first by name yield a correct program that uses none of them?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"ctl\"><span class=\"lab\" id=\"lab-ban-m\">Measure</span>\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-ban-m\" id=\"ban-m\"></div></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"ban-chart\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Survivor share under a ban of five names, per configuration\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"ban-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"note\">A <button type=\"button\" class=\"term\" data-term=\"survivor\">survivor</button> is a correct program whose algorithm is not banned. Whiskers are Wilson 95% intervals; the dashed line is the preregistered bar of <span data-k=\"ban_bar\"></span>. Source: experiment 44, <code>results/screen.json</code>.</p>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>\n    <ul class=\"limits prose\">\n      <li>The headline contrast between push and temperature ran only in an 8-bit (W8A8) engine. The push alone changes the algorithm in bfloat16 at the same absolute push norm, but the paired contrast was not repeated, and on the grid task the push moved only <span data-k=\"t1_a1\"></span> of 20 seeds.</li>\n      <li>Most results come from one model, Qwen3-8B, in non-thinking mode. The composed law was tested on <span data-k=\"law_heldout\"></span> held-out units in two other families, below the four the preregistered claim required, so its generality is open.</li>\n      <li>The law is not clearly better than the flat law, a baseline that predicts no change: it wins on <span data-k=\"law_vs_flat\"></span> units (sign test <i>p</i> = <span data-k=\"law_sign_p\"></span>). Much of its accuracy reflects how little temperature moves these units.</li>\n      <li>The temperature null rests on 20 seeds per task, which bounds the change rate per seed below <span data-k=\"cp95\"></span>, not at zero.</li>\n      <li>The tasks are short, well-known problems whose solutions are probably memorised; conclusions may not carry to open-ended programs.</li>\n      <li>Some label gates failed their strict criteria, so those numbers are descriptive. The activation-space geometry is correlational, and the map built from names is confounded by lexical overlap between algorithm names.</li>\n      <li>No control the run tested produced a correct algorithm outside the known repertoire.</li>\n    </ul>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n</main>\n\n<!-- ============================== FOOTER ============================== -->\n<footer id=\"about\" aria-labelledby=\"h-about\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-about\">Sources and glossary</h2>\n  <ul class=\"links\" style=\"margin-top:0\">\n    <li><a class=\"btn btn-primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-295f8e-prompt-bans-substitute-not-just-subtract@fork/run_jSassd-YWLVC/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a></li>\n    <li><a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-295f8e-prompt-bans-substitute-not-just-subtract@fork/run_jSassd-YWLVC/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a></li>\n    <li><a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-295f8e-prompt-bans-substitute-not-just-subtract/tree/fork/run_jSassd-YWLVC\">Code repository</a></li>\n  </ul>\n  <h3 style=\"margin-top:1.6rem\">Where each view's data comes from</h3>\n  <ul class=\"prov\" id=\"prov\"></ul>\n  <p class=\"small\">Each dataset is embedded in this page as a JSON element whose <code>data-source</code> attribute names the artifact and file it was read from. A script read those files and kept only the fields the views use; nothing was typed in by hand.</p>\n  <h3 style=\"margin-top:1.6rem\">Glossary</h3>\n  <dl class=\"gloss\" id=\"gloss\"></dl>\n</div>\n</footer>\n<div id=\"termtip\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div>\n<div id=\"marktip\" role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n<div id=\"term-defs\" class=\"sr-only\"></div>\n/*DATA*/\n<script>\n\"use strict\";\n(function(){\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ data */\nfunction J(id){return JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent);}\nvar SEEDS=J('data-seeds'), CODES=J('data-codes'), LAW=J('data-law'), STEP=J('data-stepper'), MARG=J('data-margins'),\n    WHAT=J('data-whatif'), BAN=J('data-ban'), GEO=J('data-geom');\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers */\nfunction fmt(x,d){ /* half-up rounding on the decimal value, as the paper prints */\n  if(x===null||x===undefined||isNaN(x)) return '–';\n  var neg=x<0, a=Math.abs(x), s=String(a);\n  var r;\n  if(s.indexOf('e')<0){ r=Number(Math.round(Number(s+'e'+d))+'e-'+d); }\n  else { r=Number(a.toFixed(d)); }\n  var out=r.toFixed(d);\n  if(neg && Number(out)!==0) out='−'+out;\n  return out;\n}\nfunction fmtSci(p,dig){\n  if(p===0) return '0';\n  var e=Math.floor(Math.log10(p)), m=p/Math.pow(10,e), ms=fmt(m,dig);\n  if(Number(ms)>=10){e+=1; ms=fmt(m/10,dig);}\n  return ms+' × 10<sup>−'+Math.abs(e)+'</sup>';\n}\nfunction pct(x){return fmt(100*x,0)+'%';}\nvar NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';\nfunction S(tag,attrs,parent){var e=document.createElementNS(NS,tag); if(attrs){for(var k in attrs){if(attrs[k]!==null&&attrs[k]!==undefined)e.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]);}} if(parent)parent.appendChild(e); return e;}\nfunction T(parent,x,y,str,attrs){var t=S('text',Object.assign({x:x,y:y},attrs||{}),parent); t.textContent=str; return t;}\nfunction H(tag,attrs,html){var e=document.createElement(tag); if(attrs){for(var k in attrs){if(k==='class')e.className=attrs[k]; else e.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]);}} if(html!==undefined)e.innerHTML=html; return e;}\nfunction esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>\"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','\"':'&quot;'}[c];});}\nvar measurer=null;\nfunction textW(str,size,weight){\n  if(!measurer){measurer=S('svg',{width:0,height:0,style:'position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;visibility:hidden'}); document.body.appendChild(measurer);}\n  var t=S('text',{'font-size':size,'font-weight':weight||400,'font-family':getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily},measurer); t.textContent=str;\n  var w=t.getComputedTextLength(); """Inject the extracted JSON datasets into the page template and write interactive.html."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
DATA = HERE / 'data'
DEST = Path('/ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_jSassd-YWLVC/4_gen_paper_repo/_4_assemble_paper/paper/interactive.html')

ELEMENTS = [
    ('data-seeds', 'seeds.json', 'gen_art_experiment_21: data/labels.jsonl, results/c1seed.json, prompts/prompts.jsonl'),
    ('data-codes', 'codes.json', 'gen_art_experiment_21: data/labels.jsonl (field code, one entry per distinct code_sha256)'),
    ('data-law', 'law.json', 'gen_art_experiment_43: results/analysis_L.json'),
    ('data-stepper', 'stepper.json', 'gen_art_experiment_35: results/predictions_view.json, results/forks.json, results/s4b.json; '
                                     'gen_art_experiment_43: results/analysis_L.json, results/predict_B3.json; gen_art_experiment_26: data/prompts.jsonl'),
    ('data-margins', 'margins.json', 'gen_art_experiment_43: results/base_subarm.json'),
    ('data-whatif', 'whatif.json', 'gen_art_experiment_35: results/predictions_view.json, results/test3.json; gen_art_experiment_43: results/analysis_L.json'),
    ('data-ban', 'ban.json', 'gen_art_experiment_44: results/screen.json'),
    ('data-geom', 'geom.json', 'gen_art_experiment_44: results/geometry_M1.json, results/landing.json, data/labelled_C6_ban.jsonl, '
                               'data/labelled_C6_baseline.jsonl; gen_art_experiment_46: results/geometry_32b_mname.json, '
                               'results/geometry_32b_mcode_PRIMARY_R1.json'),
]


def safe(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace('</', '<\\/').replace('<!--', '<\\!--')


def main() -> None:
    tpl = (HERE / 'page_template.html').read_text()
    blocks = []
    for el_id, fname, src in ELEMENTS:
        payload = json.loads((DATA / fname).read_text())
        text = safe(json.dumps(payload, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False))
        blocks.append(f'<script type="application/json" id="{el_id}" data-source="{src}">{text}</script>')
    out = tpl.replace('/*DATA*/', '\n'.join(blocks))
    assert '/*DATA*/' not in out
    DEST.write_text(out)
    print('wrote', DEST, len(out.encode()), 'bytes')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

**What the reader can operate**
- **The finding:** the paper's headline number (0.545, 95% CI 0.41 to 0.67), beside a grid of 20 seeds across temperatures and push directions, coloured by the algorithm each program implements.
